limitations.statement: The active acts are deterministic local collectors and permit no real external action.
Frozen Airline all-real evidence is a committed reference and cannot satisfy an executed-runtime claim.
Supplier / Water Filter portability adapter, Generic MultiRoot, and final Kernel Conformance closure remain unimplemented.

G1-A1 itself remains limited to neutral in-memory fixtures, expected-hash provenance is not external trust, and G1-A1 does not exercise signer isolation; the frozen Airline projection is separately active through G1-D1, while Supplier projection remains unimplemented.

Keys are ephemeral and in-memory with no key persistence, production identity, PKI, certificate authority, Airline Root Attestation, permission, or effect; the frozen Airline remains UNSIGNED_PLACEHOLDER with signature_verified false.

G1-B1 remains an in-memory SemanticWork and Trust conformance slice: no real cloud LLM, local SLM, or fractal runtime is executed, no provider output is trusted, and no permission, Root decision, FinalOutput, or effect is created by G1-B1; Trust Model metadata is descriptive and conformance-consumed; Kernel ABI and CausalConsumptionRef are separately active in G1-B2, Transition Registry and Root Decision Kernel are separately active in G1-C1, the mock-only Effect Firewall is separately active in G1-C2, and the frozen Airline adapter is separately active in G1-D1.

G1-B2 artifacts remain neutral in-memory conformance fixtures with no production ABI compatibility guarantee, and only ABI v1.0 is supported; CausalConsumptionRef proves declared controlled influence, not semantic truth; Transition Registry and Root Decision Kernel are separately active in G1-C1, the mock-only Effect Firewall is separately active in G1-C2, and the frozen Airline adapter is separately active in G1-D1; Supplier portability and Generic MultiRoot remain unimplemented, and no permission, Root decision, FinalOutput, connector call, or effect is created by G1-B2.

The G1-C1 Registry and decisions are domain-neutral in-memory runtime fixtures: the Registry performs lookup and does not mutate artifacts or execute transitions, and the Root Decision Kernel creates RootDecisionResult only; G1-C1 creates no permission, FinalOutput, ActionCommitPacket, ExecutionRequest, or receipt, and no effect occurs in G1-C1; the mock-only Effect Firewall is separately active in G1-C2 and the frozen Airline adapter is separately active in G1-D1; Generic MultiRoot remains unimplemented, and this is not production policy certification.

The Firewall is domain-neutral and in-memory, and its private capability is invocation-local rather than production authorization; only logical ticks and one neutral mock execution are used. No real adapter exists. No real connector, payment, booking, ticket, shipment, or external operation exists. Scope is Root-supplied conformance scope, no production permission registry is consulted, and no revocation, supersession, production retry, or distributed idempotency is implemented. The receipt is evidence only, creates no future permission, and requires later Root confirmation. The frozen Airline projection adapter is separately active in G1-D1; Supplier portability and Generic MultiRoot remain unimplemented. This is not production security certification.

The adapter is constrained to the accepted frozen Airline contract shape, Offer A, exact transaction, three Roots, type sequence, and 19 / 29 / 3 Ledger, 9 / 11 Crypto, and 19-row timeline geometry. The Living fixture is deterministic and synthetic in-memory; it does not prove byte equality with the committed all-real package, and its caller-supplied expected hash is not committed external trust. No package or filesystem access occurs and no all-real lane is rerun. The original Ledger, Crypto, Replay, Anchor, audits, Human Story, and Showcase remain unchanged. The generic Manifest is a derived projection identity, and dependency-hash CausalConsumptionRef rows do not prove semantic truth. Signature verification remains false and Root Attestation remains deferred. Supplier / Water Filter portability and Generic MultiRoot remain unimplemented. This is not production integration.
This scaffold is proof-level and is not production-ready.

public_claims.statement: The living gauntlet executes the deterministic Airline transaction collector and derives its result from the returned report.
The living gauntlet executes the all-layers invariant super-smoke and validates its returned runtime structure.
The Living Gauntlet executes the pure G1-A1 integrity and Replay core against linear and fan-out domain-neutral in-memory fixtures.

The Living Gauntlet executes the Airline Kernel adapter against a deterministic in-memory Offer A conformance fixture built from frozen Airline contracts. It preserves the exact transaction, three Roots, type sequence, 19 / 29 / 3 Ledger geometry, 9 / 11 Crypto geometry, generic Manifest and Replay PASS, and twenty-nine dependency-hash CausalConsumptionRef rows with provider, network, Gemini, and real-world effect counts at zero. It does not load or execute the committed all-real package or historical committed evidence.
The Living Gauntlet executes an in-memory Ed25519 conformance fixture proving that three test Root capabilities cannot sign or verify as one another.
The Living Gauntlet validates the eighteen-profile Kernel Trust and Compromise Model and its Root, permission, request, and bounded effect-handle boundaries.

The Living Gauntlet normalizes deterministic, informational reuse, cloud LLM, local SLM, and fractal-child provenance modes into one advisory RootReviewPacket while preserving conflicts and missing evidence.

The Living Gauntlet validates a versioned domain-neutral KernelArtifact envelope with independent identity, lifecycle, authority, payload, lineage, and time-envelope axes and converts six neutral artifacts into the G1-A1 canonical integrity subset.

The Living Gauntlet validates field-level USED, REJECTED, IGNORED_WITH_REASON, and BLOCKED_BY_GATE references and executes controlled counterfactual proofs of downstream influence or accepted-authority non-influence.

The Living Gauntlet executes the immutable domain-neutral Transition Registry, validates all eighteen canonical rules, and proves deterministic ALLOW, RETURN_TO_ROOT, NEEDS_USER, NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE, and fail-closed lookup outcomes without executing a transition.

The Living Gauntlet executes the deterministic Root Decision Kernel across ten precedence scenarios and produces in-memory RootDecisionResult objects while creating no permission, FinalOutput, effect request, connector call, or real-world effect.

The Living Gauntlet executes one Root-bound, permission-bound, scope-bound, TTL-bound, adapter-bound, one-shot mock effect through the exclusive Effect Firewall and returns an evidence-only receipt that creates no permission, Root decision, FinalOutput, connector call, or real-world effect.
The frozen Airline all-real checkpoint remains visible as committed evidence only.
The remaining Gate 1 acts are indexed for review and are not active or implemented.
